nodes.description: Private address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked from the checkBots modifier.
Public address of the Uniswap pair, set in the constructor and passed into the bot-protection call.
Internal owner address, assigned to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged gate for delegate and list.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances consumed by transferFrom and written by approve/constructor.
Public total supply used in arithmetic inside list.
Uniswap V2 router instance used to add liquidity in list.
Wrapped ETH address used to derive the Uniswap pair.
Modifier applied to transferFrom that performs an untrusted external call to botProtection before executing the wrapped function body.
Payable external transfer entry point that checks allowances, mutates balances and is guarded by checkBots.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Owner-only payable function that rewrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH and loops over recipient arrays.
Payable wrapper that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Payable function that writes the caller's allowance for a spender.
Internal pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address.
Deploys YAEToken, sets owner, derives uniPair and grants unlimited allowances.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance keys and destination balances.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the liquidity deadline in list.
Low-level external call to the botProtection address executed inside the checkBots modifier before any state change.
Arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address and calldata, guarded only by the owner check.
External payable call to the Uniswap router that also uses block.timestamp as the deadline.
Mint-style arithmetic assignment granting the caller a percentage of totalSupply.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction on the sender balance in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction on the allowance mapping in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic addition on the recipient balance in transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in balance and allowance arithmetic.
Target contract address parameter of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate.
Liquidity amount parameter of list.
Recipient array parameter of list.
Amount array parameter of list.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Boolean returned by the botProtection low-level call.
Byte payload returned by the botProtection low-level call.
Loop counter in list iterating over recipients.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller whose allowance is checked and whose balance state is updated in transferFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates balance rewriting and liquidity operations in list.
checkBots performs an external call to botProtection before the wrapped transferFrom body executes.
The external call result gates execution that later mutates balances, enabling reentry before state changes.
botProtection is the target address of the low-level call.
uniPair is passed as an argument into the botProtection call.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
_value drives allowance and balance checks inside transferFrom.
_from is the source account used for balance and allowance lookups.
_to is the destination account credited in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the caller allowance without SafeMath.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall to the supplied target.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata.
_numList sets the contract balance and liquidity amounts in list.
_tos supplies the recipient addresses iterated in list.
_amounts supplies the balances written in the list loop.
list invokes addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router.
uniRouter is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp plus 600 forms the liquidity deadline, a timestamp dependency.
msg.sender receives totalSupply * 6 / 100 in the list function.
totalSupply is multiplied and divided in the balance assignment.
The list arithmetic writes directly into the balanceOf mapping.
_amounts are assigned into balanceOf for each recipient in list.
Constructor derives and stores uniPair via pairFor.
Constructor reads msg.sender to initialize owner and allowances.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor grants the router an unlimited allowance.
Constructor grants the pair an unlimited allowance for msg.sender.
wETH is passed into pairFor to compute the pair address.
pairFor returns the address stored in uniPair.
The router addLiquidityETH call re-enters the calling context of list.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom for balance and allowance lookups.
_to is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom as the credited account.
_value is the transferFrom parameter driving the allowance and balance arithmetic.
Parameter a is used exclusively as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is used exclusively as delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
_numList is a list-only parameter setting contract balance and liquidity amount.
_tos is the recipient array iterated only inside list.
_amounts is the amount array written to balances only inside list.
_spender is the approve parameter used as the allowance key.
notABot is the boolean result of the botProtection low-level external call.
isNotBot is the bytes result of the botProtection low-level external call.
Loop counter i exists only to iterate the recipient arrays inside list.
